newsitem.title: UK: UK cash markets lower, trade thin.
newsitem.headline: UK cash markets lower, trade thin.

text.p: UK cash grain markets were mostly lower on Tuesday, but trade was thin.
Brokers said there was no follow-through trading on either the fob or delivered markets.
"There are only a few odds and ends being done, nothing follows on," said another broker.
Feed wheat traded on the fob market at 98.50 stg for Apr/Jun ex-east coast ports
On the delivered market milling wheat 11 percent protein in East Anglia traded at 112 stg for February.
Feed wheat in West Norfolk traded at 97 stg for Mar and 98.50 and 99 stg for April.
